atoms.text: Now Tina is going to show you some airports around the world.

instruction.text: Select the three images of airports around the world.

feedback.finish: There are over 40,000 airports in the world, so people and cargo can get anywhere! Some only fly within the country, while others fly internationally.
feedback.wrong: This is the Sahara Desert in Africa.

instruction.text: This is Changi Airport in Singapore. Select the waterfall to learn more.

feedback.end: This area is called Jewel Changi Airport and is made for travellers to have fun while waiting! It has the tallest indoor waterfall in the world, an indoor garden and a leisure park!

instruction.text: This is Vienna International Airport in Austria. Select one of the signs to learn more.

feedback.end: Larger airports like this one will usually have more than one terminal and lots of boarding gates. Moving walkways can help you get to your gate faster.

instruction.text: This is Tenzing-Hillary Airport in Nepal. Select the plane to learn more.

feedback.end: This is known as the most dangerous airport in the world! It’s very small, high-up and surrounded by mountains. Brave hikers fly here to start their trek up Mount Everest.

instruction.text: Tina wants to know what you will normally find at airports. Drag each image to the correct group.

hint.text: Select an image to hear what it is.

feedback.finish: Great! Even though airports around the world can be very different, there are some important things that they will usually all have.

instruction.text: Let’s do some fieldwork! Tina wants to compare Changi Airport with Tenzing-Hillary Airport. Answer her questions.

atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>Which airport is larger?</prosody></voice>

atoms.a: “Which airport is surrounded by tall mountains?”

atoms.a: “Which airport can you see lots of planes waiting at?”
